result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue on the page.

issues.description: The delivery time label '25-35 min' on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar listing overlaps with the '€0 delivery' badge text, causing both pieces of text to render on top of each other and become unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Separate the delivery time and delivery fee into distinct UI elements with proper spacing so they do not overlap. Consider placing them on separate lines or using a layout that prevents collision between the badge and the delivery info text.
